requisito: Computes the arithmetic mean of an integer array of grades as a double. If the array is null or empty, it returns 0.

difetti.spiegazione: somma and voti.Length are both int, so somma / voti.Length performs integer division, truncating the fractional part before converting to double.

difetti.indizio: Look at the if condition at the start of the function.
difetti.spiegazione: The guard only checks voti.Length == 0 without checking voti == null first: when null is passed, accessing voti!.Length throws a NullReferenceException.
